notes: WLC.EZK.47.8.v001 is underdetermined and resolved to r00-base; the retained reading has the same token count as its alternative, so rule 53 does not engage.
'These waters' has a written demonstrative, so under rule 41's limit אֵלֶּה takes the determiner and both article morphemes are unrepresented.
